official.tuition_coverage_note: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver: Complete exemption from tuition fees (UKT) during all 8 academic semesters of S1 study.
benefits: 100% Tuition Fee Waiver: complete exemption from tuition fees (UKT) during all 8 academic semesters of S1 study
Monthly Living Allowance: a recurring monthly stipend of IDR 4,700,000 transferred directly to help cover off-campus housing and general living costs
One-Time Arrival Settlement: an upfront initial settlement allowance of IDR 10,000,000 paid upon landing to secure private off-campus accommodation
Round-Trip International Flights (At-Cost): economy class flight ticket from the capital city of the home nation to Jakarta (CGK), including local travel to the ITB Bandung campus
Basic Health Insurance: comprehensive health coverage for necessary inpatient care, outpatient treatment, and accidental emergencies within Indonesia (excluding aesthetic care)
Visa Fees: waiver or direct reimbursement for standard student visa application and regulatory processing
eligibility: Applicants must be Non-Indonesian Citizens (Non-WNI) and hold a valid passport or official citizenship from one of the designated partner countries in the ASEAN & Asia-Pacific or Africa regions
Must possess a 12-Year High School Diploma (or equivalent official senior high school credentials); anyone who already holds or is pursuing an S1 degree is ineligible
Minimum cumulative high school grades equivalent to a GPA of 3.00 out of a 4.00 scale

Valid English proficiency certificate obtained within the last 2 years: TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63, IELTS 6.0, or an equivalent Duolingo English Test; official school statements confirming English as the primary medium of instruction are acceptable
Must submit a certified medical report, not be an active military service member, and demonstrate a clean criminal record verified by home country authorities
Non-diplomatic passport valid at least until December 31st, 2027
requirements: All registration processes must be completed through ITB's centralized online financial aid management portal
Application form - personal information: Full Name (as in Passport), Country of Citizenship, Date of Birth, Passport Number
Application form - academic profile and language scores: High School Name, Cumulative HS GPA (min 3.00), English Test Type (IELTS/TOEFL/TOEIC/Duolingo), Language Test Score
Application form - desired ITB S1 study programs: First Program Choice, Second Program Choice, Personal Statement Video Link (YouTube Link)
All documents scanned into clear digital formats with a maximum file size of 300kb each
documents: Valid passport scan: non-diplomatic passport valid at least until December 31st, 2027
12-Yr High School Diploma: legalized high school graduation certificate and transcript documentation
School Recommendation Letter: an academic recommendation signed by the principal or proper counselor from the previous high school
Personal Profile Video: a short video presentation uploaded to YouTube explaining the applicant's background, why they want to study in Indonesia, and their academic goals at ITB
Embassy Recommendation Letter (optional): a formal letter of recommendation issued by the Indonesian Embassy (KBRI) or Consulate General in the country of origin - not mandatory, only if available

applicant_utility.summary: ITB's fully funded international undergraduate award waives UKT tuition for all eight semesters, pays a recurring IDR 4,700,000 monthly allowance plus an IDR 10,000,000 arrival settlement, and adds an at-cost round-trip economy flight, basic health insurance and student visa fee cover. The real constraint is that ITB provides no dormitory, so that stipend has to fund private rental housing in Bandung, and the award bans paid work, any second scholarship, bringing family, and even changing programme. The published 2026 window closed on 1 July 2026 with results announced on 16 July, so an applicant's job right now is to watch the FinAid page for the next cycle and have legalised credentials and a public YouTube personal-statement video ready in advance.
applicant_utility.best_fit: A recent high-school graduate from a designated ASEAN, Asia-Pacific or African partner country holding a 3.00/4.00 GPA and IELTS 6.0-level English who can self-fund the move to Bandung and live disciplined within a fixed monthly stipend.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your country sits inside ITB's designated partner list before spending on documents - the page names only the ASEAN & Asia-Pacific and Africa regions, not individual countries
Book the English test early and keep the certificate inside two years; TOEFL ITP 550, TOEFL iBT 63 and IELTS 6.0 are the published floors
Get the high-school diploma and transcript legalised in advance and compress every scan below 300kb
Check passport validity runs past 31 December 2027 - renew early if it does not
Record the personal-statement video, upload it to YouTube and set it to public so reviewers can open the link
Ask the principal or counsellor for the recommendation letter early - school officials are the classic bottleneck in a five-week window
common_rejection_risks: Passport expiring before 31 December 2027 - an administrative fail no strong academic record can rescue
English certificate older than two years or below the published minimum score
Unlegalised or incomplete high-school certificate and transcript documentation
Uploaded files exceeding 300kb, or a private/unlisted YouTube video link reviewers cannot open
Already holding or currently studying an S1 degree, or holding a credential below the required 12-year school system
Applying to Architecture or FSRD without preparing for the drawing test stage
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Private off-campus rent in Bandung beyond what the IDR 4,700,000 monthly stipend covers, personal expenses, any travel costs above the published at-cost economy arrangement, and all costs for dependants (ITB provides none and prohibits bringing family). Tuition for repeated courses is not addressed in the publication.
document_audit: Every scan must be clear and no larger than 300kb - heavy scans of legalised diplomas and transcripts are the usual failure point
The passport must be non-diplomatic and valid at least until 31 December 2027
The recommendation letter must be signed by the principal or a proper counselor, not a subject teacher
The personal statement must be a public YouTube link, not an uploaded video file
The English test certificate must be dated within two years of submission
A certified medical report and evidence of a clean criminal record are checked at the eligibility stage, so start home-country attestation early
alerts: The published 2026 intake closed on 1 July 2026 and the page (updated 29 June 2026) shows no 2027 dates - expect a similar June-July cycle and pre-stage documents before the next window opens
Accepting any other scholarship or financial aid terminates this award immediately, and any part-time or full-time work is banned under Indonesian immigration rules
Awardees may not marry Indonesian citizens, permanent residents or fellow recipients, may not bring dependants, and may not change programme or transfer university
Assessment is compressed: after the 1 July submission cut-off, ELQ, AQ and drawing tests run 6-8 July, results land on 16 July and re-registration closes on 24 July, leaving almost no recovery time
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on the ITB international scholarship portal, upload the six document types inside the submission window, then pass the staged assessments - finalization, the ITB AQ & ELQ simulation, the 6 July ELQ and 8 July AQ tests plus 7 July drawing tests for Architecture and FSRD - before re-registering in the July window.
